# Main: Timepoint vs percent of cells filtered out
```{r}
df <- seurat.obj@meta.data %>%
  group_by(timepoint, sample.id) %>%
  summarize(percent.filtered.out = 100 * (sum(low.quality.by.qc) / n())) %>%
  ungroup()
df$timepoint <- factor(df$timepoint, levels = timepoints)
write.table(df, paste0(figures.dir, "sussman2024_percent_filtered_out_by_sample.tsv"), sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = F)

# these statistics go in main text
df %>% group_by(timepoint) %>% summarize(median.percent.filtered.out = median(percent.filtered.out)) %>% print()

stat.test <- df %>%
  wilcox_test(percent.filtered.out ~ timepoint, ref.group = "Progressive (Autopsy)") %>%
  add_significance() %>% 
  adjust_pvalue(method = "fdr") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "timepoint")
stat.test$p.label <- sapply(stat.test$p.adj, format.p.value)

p <- ggplot(df, aes(timepoint, percent.filtered.out)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = timepoint), outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), color = "black", alpha = 0.6) +
  theme(legend.position="none") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.label", label.size = 6) +
  xlab("Timepoint") +
  ylab("Percent of cells filtered out (%)") +
  ylim(c(-5, 100)) +
  timepoints.fill.scale +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
pdf(paste0(figures.dir, 'timepoint_vs_percent.filtered.out.pdf'), width=10, height=10)
print(p)
dev.off()
```



# Main: transcriptional noise by cell type (PCA)
```{r}
patient.id.use <- "C34809"
seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = (patient_id == patient.id.use) & (low.quality.by.qc == FALSE))
outliers <- c("HTAN_pHGG_6477_Reg2_snRNA_CTTAGGAAGTCTGGTT-1")

plot.list <- list()
for (celltype.use in c("Lymphoid", "Myeloid", "Endothelial", "Malignant cluster")) { 
  
  seurat.obj.subset.celltype <- subset(seurat.obj.subset, subset = (annotation.l2.w.qc == celltype.use) & (cell.id %ni% outliers))
  seurat.obj.subset.celltype <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat.obj.subset.celltype)
  seurat.obj.subset.celltype <- ScaleData(seurat.obj.subset.celltype)
  
  set.seed(123)
  seurat.obj.subset.celltype <- RunPCA(seurat.obj.subset.celltype, features = VariableFeatures(seurat.obj.subset), approx = T, seed.use = 42, npcs = 30)
  
  p <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.subset.celltype, group.by = "timepoint", shuffle = T, label = F, raster=F, reduction = "pca") + timepoints.color.scale + ggtitle(celltype.use) 
  
  plot.list[[celltype.use]] <- p
  
}

p <- patchwork::wrap_plots(plot.list, ncol = 2) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.justification = "center"
  )
pdf(paste0(figures.dir, "sussman2024pHGG_", patient.id.use, "_pca_by_timepoint.pdf"), width=12, height=8)
print(p)
dev.off()

rm(seurat.obj.subset)
```






# Supplementary Table S4: Sussman 2024 timepoint DEGs
```{r}
library(DESeq2)


# 1. Identify which groups meet the 5-cell threshold
cell_counts <- seurat.obj@meta.data %>%
  group_by(sample.id, patient_id, timepoint, annotation.l1) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  # Force hyphens to underscores to ensure a clean match later
  mutate(column_id = paste(sample.id, patient_id, timepoint, annotation.l1, sep = "_")) %>%
  mutate(column_id = gsub("-", "_", column_id))

# 2. Generate pseudobulk data
pb <- AggregateExpression(
  seurat.obj,
  assays = "RNA",
  slot = "counts",
  group.by = c("sample.id", "patient_id", "timepoint", "annotation.l1"),
  return.seurat = FALSE
)

counts <- pb$RNA

# 3. Align column names and filter
# First, store the ORIGINAL colnames to split later, 
# but create a temporary version with underscores to match cell_counts
original_colnames <- colnames(counts)
colnames_matched <- gsub("-", "_", original_colnames)

# Identify which columns (using the matched naming) meet the threshold
valid_indices <- which(colnames_matched %in% cell_counts$column_id[cell_counts$n_cells >= 5])

# Subset the matrix using original names to keep your strsplit logic working
counts_filtered <- counts[, valid_indices]

# 4. Extract metadata from the filtered column names
meta_list <- strsplit(colnames(counts_filtered), "_")
meta <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, meta_list))
colnames(meta) <- c("sample_id", "patient_id", "timepoint", "celltype")

# Update terminology: Living -> Surgical
meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(status = ifelse(timepoint == "Progressive (Autopsy)", "Postmortem", "Surgical")) %>%
  mutate(status = factor(status, levels = c("Surgical", "Postmortem")))

# 5. Run DEG analysis per cell type
results_list <- list()

for (ct in unique(meta$celltype)) {
  message("Analyzing: ", ct)
  
  keep_cols <- meta$celltype == ct
  ct_counts <- counts_filtered[, keep_cols]
  ct_meta   <- meta[keep_cols, ]
  
  if(length(unique(ct_meta$status)) < 2) {
    message("  Skipping ", ct, ": Missing one of the status groups (n < 5 cells).")
    next
  }

  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = ct_counts,
    colData   = ct_meta,
    design    = ~ status
  )

  dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 3, ]
  dds <- DESeq(dds, quiet = TRUE)
  
  res <- results(dds, contrast = c("status", "Postmortem", "Surgical"))
  
  res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
  res_df$gene <- rownames(res_df)
  res_df$cell_type <- ct
  results_list[[ct]] <- res_df
}

# 6. Combine and clean results
all_results <- bind_rows(results_list)
all_results$cell_type <- sapply(all_results$cell_type, function(x) ifelse(x == "Malignant cluster", "Malignant", x))

# 7. Summary table
all_results_summary <- all_results %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0.5) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarize(
    n_cell_types = n(),
    avg_log2fc = mean(log2FoldChange),
    cell_types = paste(cell_type, collapse = ", ")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_cell_types))

# 8. Export
writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    "All DEGs" = all_results,
    "Top postmortem DEGs" = all_results_summary
  ),
  paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Tables/", "Table S4 postmortem DEGs from Sussman 2024.xlsx")
)
```



## Main: Postmortem gene signatures

# Quantification of transcripts of postmortem signature genes
```{r}
run.chunk <- F

if (run.chunk) {
  library(biomaRt)
  
  ensembl <- useEnsembl(
    biomart = "ensembl",
    dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl",
    version = 109   # pick the Ensembl version matching your reference if possible
  )
  
  tx_lengths <- getBM(
    attributes = c(
      "hgnc_symbol",
      "ensembl_transcript_id",
      "transcript_length",
      "transcript_biotype"
    ),
    filters = "biotype",
    values  = "protein_coding",
    mart    = ensembl
  )
  
  gene_length_summary <- tx_lengths %>%
    filter(hgnc_symbol != "") %>%
    group_by(hgnc_symbol) %>%
    summarise(
      n_isoforms   = n(),
      min_tx_len   = min(transcript_length, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_tx_len= median(transcript_length, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_tx_len   = max(transcript_length, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  
  signature.use <- "postmortem.sensitive"
  postmortem.transcripts <- all.gene.signatures[[signature.use]]
  
  transcript_lengths <- gene_length_summary %>%
    filter(hgnc_symbol %in% postmortem.transcripts)
  
  any(rowSums(seurat.obj) == 0)
  
  background_lengths <- gene_length_summary %>%
    filter(!hgnc_symbol %in% postmortem.transcripts)
  
  quantile(transcript_lengths$median_tx_len)
  quantile(transcript_lengths$max_tx_len)
  quantile(transcript_lengths$n_isoforms)
  
  quantile(background_lengths$median_tx_len)
  quantile(background_lengths$max_tx_len)
  quantile(background_lengths$n_isoforms)
  
  
  background_lengths$annotation <- "background"
  transcript_lengths$annotation <- signature.use
  df <- rbind(background_lengths, transcript_lengths)
  
  ggplot(df, aes(annotation, max_tx_len)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    stat_compare_means(ref.group = "background", method.args = list(alternative = "two.sided"))
  
  ggplot(df, aes(annotation, min_tx_len)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    stat_compare_means(ref.group = "background", method.args = list(alternative = "two.sided"))
  
  ggplot(df, aes(annotation, median_tx_len)) +
    geom_boxplot()+
    stat_compare_means(ref.group = "background", method.args = list(alternative = "two.sided"))
  
  ggplot(df, aes(annotation, n_isoforms)) +
    geom_boxplot()+
    stat_compare_means(ref.group = "background", method.args = list(alternative = "two.sided"))
}
```




# Settings
Run with with signatures.use = 3d_tensor_decomp_signatures (3D tensor decomposition signatures that gave us the postmortem signatures)   
or signatures.use = 2d_nmf_signatures (2D NMF signatures as comparison)   
```{r}
update.gene.signature.names <- function(x) {
  y <- case_when(
    x == "postmortem.glial.factor.100" ~ "Postmortem glial\n(top 100 from factor)",
    x == "postmortem.glial.factor.50" ~ "Postmortem glial\n(top 50 from factor)",
    x == "postmortem.signature.factor" ~ "Postmortem enriched\n(top 100 from factor)",
    x == "postmortem.sensitive.factor" ~ "Living enriched\n(top 100 from factor)",
    x == "heat.shock.signature.9" ~ "Hypoxia heat shock\n(top 100 from factor, rank 9)",
    x == "heat.shock.signature.10" ~ "Hypoxia heat shock\n(top 100 from factor, rank 10)",
    x == "postmortem.glial" ~ "Postmortem glial",
    x == "postmortem.signature" ~ "Postmortem enriched\n(refined)",
    x == "postmortem.sensitive" ~ "Living enriched\n(refined)",
    x == "heat.shock.signature" ~ "Hypoxia heat shock\n(refined)",
    x == "liv.degs.all" ~ "Liharska 2025 LIV DEGs\n(n=7250)",
    x == "pm.degs.all" ~ "Liharska 2025 PM DEGs\n(n=6771)",
    x == "liv.degs" ~ "Liharska 2025 LIV DEGs\n(top 100)",
    x == "pm.degs" ~ "Liharska 2025 PM DEGs\n(top 100)",
    x == "malignant.factor" ~ "Malignant signature\n(top 100 from factor)",
    x == "neurons.factor" ~ "Neuronal signature\n(top 100 from factor)",
    x == "vascular.factor" ~ "Vascular signature\n(top 100 from factor)",
    x == "glial.factor" ~ "Glial signature\n(top 100 from factor)",
    x == "immune.factor" ~ "Immune signature\n(top 100 from factor)",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
  return(y)
}


signatures.use <- "3d_tensor_decomp_signatures" # "3d_tensor_decomp_signatures", or "2d_nmf_signatures"

if (signatures.use == "3d_tensor_decomp_signatures") {
  gene.signatures <- all.gene.signatures[c("heat.shock.signature.9", "heat.shock.signature.10", "postmortem.sensitive.factor", "postmortem.signature.factor", "postmortem.glial.factor.100", "postmortem.glial.factor.50", "glial.factor", "immune.factor", "malignant.factor", "neurons.factor", "vascular.factor", "liv.degs.all", "pm.degs.all", "liv.degs", "pm.degs", "heat.shock.signature", "postmortem.sensitive", "postmortem.signature", "postmortem.glial")]
} else if (signatures.use == "2d_nmf_signatures") {
  MP_list_df <- read.csv(paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "Sussman2024/", "NMF/", "all.timepoints_all.cell.types_top.n.genes10000_nmf.methodRcppML/", "MP_list_df.tsv"), sep="\t")
  gene.signatures <- list()
  for (mp in names(MP_list_df)) {
    gene.signatures[mp] <- MP_list_df[mp]
  }
}

factors <- c(names(gene.signatures), "percent.mt")

```



# Save signatures as Excel file (supplementary table)
```{r}
save.signatures <- T

if ((signatures.use == "3d_tensor_decomp_signatures") && (save.signatures)) {
  gene.signatures.save <- all.gene.signatures[c("glial.factor", "immune.factor", "malignant.factor", "neurons.factor", "vascular.factor",  "postmortem.glial.factor.100", "postmortem.signature.factor", "postmortem.signature", "postmortem.sensitive.factor", "postmortem.sensitive", "heat.shock.signature.9", "heat.shock.signature.10", "heat.shock.signature")]
  updated.colnames <- sapply(names(gene.signatures.save), update.gene.signature.names)
  updated.colnames <- str_replace(updated.colnames, "\n", " ")
  
  # find the length of the longest signature
  max_len <- max(sapply(gene.signatures.save, length))
  
  # pad shorter signatures with NA so they're all the same length
  gene.signatures.save.padded <- lapply(gene.signatures.save, function(x) {
    c(x, rep(NA, max_len - length(x)))
  })
  
  # convert to a data frame and export as excel
  gene.sigantures.save.df <- as.data.frame(gene.signatures.save.padded)
  colnames(gene.sigantures.save.df) <- updated.colnames
  openxlsx::write.xlsx(gene.sigantures.save.df, file = paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Tables/", "Table S5 postmortem signatures.xlsx"))
}
```

# Main: Timepoint vs metaprogram score by metaprogram
```{r}
seurat.obj <- add.module.score(seurat.obj, gene.signatures)
seurat.obj$cell.type.annotation <- seurat.obj$annotation.l1
celltypes.use <- sort(unique(seurat.obj$cell.type.annotation))

df <- seurat.obj@meta.data
df$Timepoint <- factor(df$Timepoint, levels = timepoints.broad)
df.long <- df %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(all_of(factors), percent.mt), names_to = "metaprogram", values_to = "score")

sample.df <- df.long %>% 
  group_by(metaprogram, Timepoint, timepoint.original, sample.id) %>% 
  summarize(mean.score = mean(score), count = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

plot.list <- list()
for (i in factors) {
  print(i)
  temp.df <- sample.df %>% filter(metaprogram == i)
  
  metaprogram.name.updated <- update.gene.signature.names(i)
  
  stat.test <- temp.df %>%
    wilcox_test(mean.score ~ Timepoint, ref.group = "Surgical") %>% 
    adjust_pvalue(method = "fdr") %>%
    add_significance("p") %>%
    add_xy_position()
  stat.test$p.label <- format.p.value(stat.test$p.adj)
  
  p <- ggplot(temp.df, aes(Timepoint, mean.score)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Timepoint), outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_point(color = "black", position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), alpha = 0.6) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position="none", axis.text=element_text(size=16), axis.title=element_text(size=16,face="bold"), plot.title = element_text(size=16)) +
    stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.label", label.size = 5) +
    ggtitle(metaprogram.name.updated) +
    xlab("Timepoint") +
    ylab("Metaprogram score") +
    timepoints.broad.fill.scale +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  plot.list[[i]] <- p
}
p <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plot.list)

if (signatures.use == "3d_tensor_decomp_signatures") {
  pdf(paste0(figures.dir, signatures.use, "_timepoint_vs_metaprogram_score_by_metaprogram.pdf"), width = 20, height=30)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
} else if (signatures.use == "2d_nmf_signatures") {
  pdf(paste0(figures.dir, signatures.use, "_timepoint_vs_metaprogram_score_by_metaprogram.pdf"), width = 20, height=24)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
}
```

# Supplemental: Metaprograms in healthy datasets (Velmeshev 2019 and Herring 2022)
```{r}
# all Herring 2022 data no filter from raw coutns
herring2022 <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ExternalData/", 'Herring_2022/', 'processed/', 'all.sampled.merged.downsampled.seurat.obj.RDS'))
herring2022 <- subset(herring2022, subset = is.sample.organoid_ == FALSE)

herring2022 <- add.module.score(herring2022, gene.signatures)

factors <- names(gene.signatures)
df.long <- herring2022@meta.data %>% pivot_longer(cols = all_of(factors), names_to = "metaprogram", values_to = "score")
df.long$celltype <- df.long$annotation_l1.w.qc

cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality.herring <- c(cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality, c("Poor.Quality", "No.metadata"))
cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality.fill.scale.herring <- scale_fill_manual(breaks=cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality.herring, values=c(palette.colors(palette = "Okabe-Ito")[2:(length(cell.types.anotation_l1)+1)], "#CC79A7", "#808080", "brown", "grey"))

df <- df.long %>%
  group_by(library.id_, celltype, metaprogram) %>%
  summarize(mean.metaprogram.score = mean(score), count = n()) %>%
  filter(count >= 10) %>%
  ungroup()

df$metaprogram <- factor(df$metaprogram, levels = factors)
df$celltype <- factor(df$celltype, levels = cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality.herring)

p <- ggplot(df, aes(celltype, mean.metaprogram.score, fill = celltype)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), alpha = 0.5, shape = 21, color = "black") + 
  facet_wrap(~metaprogram, scales = "free") + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) +
  theme(legend.position="none") +
  cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality.fill.scale.herring +
  ylab("Metaprogram score")
pdf(paste0(supp.figures.dir, "herring2022_celltype_vs_metoprogram_score_by_metaprogram.pdf"), width = 30, height=30)
print(p)
dev.off()

rm(herring2022)


# all Velmeshev2019 data no filter from raw counts
velmeshev2019 <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ExternalData/", 'Velmeshev_2019_Autism/', 'SeuratObjects/', 'raw.velmeshev2019.autism.all.cells.seurat.obj.RDS'))

velmeshev2019 <- add.module.score(velmeshev2019, gene.signatures)

df.long <- velmeshev2019@meta.data %>% pivot_longer(cols = all_of(factors), names_to = "metaprogram", values_to = "score")
df.long$celltype <- df.long$annotation_l1.w.qc

df <- df.long %>%
  group_by(sample, celltype, metaprogram) %>%
  summarize(mean.metaprogram.score = mean(score), count = n()) %>%
  filter(count >= 10) %>%
  ungroup()

df$metaprogram <- factor(df$metaprogram, levels = factors)
df$celltype <- factor(df$celltype, levels = cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality)

p <- ggplot(df, aes(celltype, mean.metaprogram.score, fill = celltype)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), alpha = 0.5, shape = 21, color = "black") + 
  facet_wrap(~metaprogram, scales = "free") + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) +
  theme(legend.position="none") +
  cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality.fill.scale +
  ylab("Metaprogram score")
pdf(paste0(supp.figures.dir, "velmeshev2019_celltype_vs_metaprogram_score_by_metaprogram.pdf"), width = 30, height=30)
print(p)
dev.off()

rm(velmeshev2019)
```



# Supplemental: Cell type metaprogram heatmap
If R crashes here (too much memory), run 1) # Setup at the very top 2) # Main: Metaprograms # Settings (sets up gene signatures) and then run below here
```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(mclust)

seurat.obj.downsample <- seurat.obj

# downsample for speed/prevents crashing
seurat.obj.downsample$downsample <- T
Idents(seurat.obj.downsample) <- "annotation.l1"

table(seurat.obj.downsample$annotation.l1)

set.seed(123)
seurat.obj.downsample <- subset(seurat.obj.downsample, subset = (downsample == T & low.quality.by.qc == FALSE), downsample = 1000)

seurat.obj.downsample <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.downsample, gene.signatures)
print(dim(seurat.obj.downsample))

cell_type <- seurat.obj.downsample$annotation.l1
cell_type <- factor(cell_type, 
  levels = cell.types.anotation_l1
)

data <- seurat.obj.downsample@meta.data %>% dplyr::select(names(gene.signatures))
data_scaled <- scale(data, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)


max_abs <- 3
col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(-max_abs, 0, max_abs),
  c("blue", "white", "red")
)

annotation.colors <- cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality.colors
names(annotation.colors) <- cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality

row_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  Annotation = cell_type,
  col = list(Annotation = annotation.colors),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

if (signatures.use == "3d_tensor_decomp_signatures") {
  
  data_scaled <- data_scaled[, c("glial.factor", "immune.factor", "malignant.factor", "neurons.factor", "vascular.factor")]
  colnames(data_scaled) <- c("Glial signature", "Immune signature", "Malignant signature", "Neuronal signature", "Vascular signature")
  
} else if (signatures.use == "2d_nmf_signatures") {
    
  data_scaled <- data_scaled[, c("MP_6", "MP_3", "MP_1", "MP_9", "MP_8", "MP_4", "MP_5", "MP_11", "MP_7", "MP_2")]

}

dist_matrix <- as.dist(1 - cor(t(data_scaled), method = "pearson"))
hc <- hclust(dist_matrix, method = "average")
clusters <- cutree(hc, k = 5)
ari_score <- adjustedRandIndex(as.character(cell_type), clusters)
print(ari_score)


p <- Heatmap(data_scaled, name = "Cell type signatures", 
             cluster_rows = hc, show_row_names = FALSE, row_title_rot = 0, 
             cluster_columns = TRUE, column_names_centered = TRUE,  column_names_rot = 0, column_title = paste0("ARI=", round(ari_score, 2)),
             col = col_fun, right_annotation = row_ha, row_split = 5)



pdf(paste0(supp.figures.dir, signatures.use, "_cells_vs_metaprogram_heatmap_by_celltype.pdf"), width = 12, height=8)
draw(p, padding = unit(c(20, 5, 5, 5), "mm"))
dev.off()
```



# Supplemental: Timepoint metaprogram heatmap
```{r}
seurat.obj.downsample <- seurat.obj

seurat.obj.downsample$downsample <- T
Idents(seurat.obj.downsample) <- "Timepoint"
set.seed(123)
seurat.obj.downsample <- subset(seurat.obj.downsample, subset = (downsample == T), downsample = 1000)

seurat.obj.downsample <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.downsample, gene.signatures)
print(dim(seurat.obj.downsample))


timepoint <- seurat.obj.downsample$Timepoint
timepoint <- factor(timepoint, levels = timepoints.broad)
names(timepoint) <- rownames(seurat.obj.downsample@meta.data)

data <- seurat.obj.downsample@meta.data %>% dplyr::select(names(gene.signatures))
data_scaled <- scale(data, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
max_abs <- 3
col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(-max_abs, 0, max_abs),
  c("blue", "white", "red")
)

annotation.colors <- timepoints.broad.colors
names(annotation.colors) <- timepoints.broad

row_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  Annotation = timepoint,
  col = list(Annotation = annotation.colors),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)



if (signatures.use == "3d_tensor_decomp_signatures") {
  
  data_scaled <- data_scaled[, c("postmortem.sensitive", "postmortem.signature", "heat.shock.signature")]
  colnames(data_scaled) <- c("Living enriched", "Posmortem enriched", "Hypoxia heat shock")
  
  dist_matrix <- as.dist(1 - cor(t(data_scaled), method = "pearson"))
  hc <- hclust(dist_matrix, method = "average")
  clusters <- cutree(hc, k = 2)
  ari_score <- adjustedRandIndex(as.character(timepoint), clusters)
  print(ari_score)
  
  p <- Heatmap(data_scaled, name = "Postmortem signatures",
               cluster_rows = hc, show_row_names = FALSE, row_title_rot = 0, 
               cluster_columns = TRUE, column_names_centered = TRUE,  column_names_rot = 0, column_title = paste0("ARI=", round(ari_score, 2)),
               col = col_fun, right_annotation = row_ha, row_split=2)
  
  pdf(paste0(supp.figures.dir, signatures.use, "_cells_vs_metaprogram_heatmap_by_timepoint.pdf"), width = 8, height=8)
  ht <- draw(p, padding = unit(c(20, 5, 5, 5), "mm"))
  dev.off()
  
  
} else if (signatures.use == "2d_nmf_signatures") {
  
  mp10 <- as.matrix(data_scaled[, "MP_10", drop = FALSE])
  
  ord <- order(mp10[, 1], decreasing = TRUE)
  mp10_ord <- mp10[ord, , drop = FALSE]
  
  set.seed(123)
  km <- kmeans(mp10_ord[, 1], centers = 2)
  clusters <- factor(km$cluster)
  
  ari_score <- adjustedRandIndex(
    as.character(timepoint[rownames(mp10_ord)]),
    clusters
  )
  
  p <- Heatmap(
    mp10_ord,
    name = "Postmortem signatures",
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    show_row_names = FALSE,
    column_names_rot = 0,
    column_names_centered = TRUE,
    col = col_fun,
    width = unit(2, "cm"),
    right_annotation = row_ha[ord],
    row_split = clusters,
    column_title = paste0("ARI=", round(ari_score, 2))
  )
  
  pdf(paste0(supp.figures.dir, signatures.use, "_cells_vs_metaprogram_heatmap_by_timepoint.pdf"), width = 8, height=8)
  ht <- draw(p, padding = unit(c(20, 5, 5, 5), "mm"))
  dev.off()

}
```
